name: Wage-and-hour and OSHA enforcement by county, state, act and industry (U.S. Department of Labor)
description: What the U.S. Department of Labor found when it enforced wage and safety laws, counted by county, state and territory and for the US over the last ten complete federal fiscal years. From the Wage and Hour Division (WHD): concluded cases, cases with violations, back wages found owed, employees owed back wages, civil money penalties, Fair Labor Standards Act overtime and minimum wage back wages, and child labor violations. From the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), federal and state-plan offices: inspections (and how many followed a complaint, a referral, an accident or a fatality or catastrophe), violations cited (serious, willful, repeat), and penalties. State and US records add one record per law WHD enforces (FLSA, FMLA, Davis-Bacon, the Service Contract Act, H-2A, H-2B, H-1B, MSPA and others) and one per industry sector. Only counts and sums are published: no employer name, address or case number, and back wages only where 3 or more employees were owed.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Wage-and-hour and OSHA enforcement by county, state, act and industry (U.S. Department of Labor) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898146
keywords: Wage and Hour Division enforcement data

distribution.name: wage-enforcement.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: wage-enforcement.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: wage-enforcement-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in wage-enforcement-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to wage-enforcement.csv on id.

recordSet.name: wage-enforcement
recordSet.description: The records of Wage-and-hour and OSHA enforcement by county, state, act and industry (U.S. Department of Labor), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter code of the state or territory, or US

field.name: level
field.description: county, county-not-given (cases and inspections in the state whose ZIP code places them in no county of it), state, state-not-given (no usable state code), us, act (one law WHD enforces, state or US) or industry (one NAICS sector, state or US)

field.name: year
field.description: The latest complete federal fiscal year in the record (FY N runs October 1 of N-1 to September 30 of N)

field.name: fiscalYears
field.description: The ten fiscal years covered

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Back wages WHD found owed over the ten fiscal years, in dollars

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of value

field.name: whd_cases_10y
field.description: WHD cases over the ten fiscal years

field.name: whd_back_wages_10y
field.description: Back wages over the ten fiscal years, in dollars

field.name: whd_employees_owed_10y
field.description: Employees due back wages over the ten fiscal years

field.name: whd_penalties_10y
field.description: Civil money penalties over the ten fiscal years, in dollars

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
